============================================================================
OmniBuf-PHP Benchmark Suite (PHP 8.6.0 / darwin-arm64 / Apple M1 Pro)
Workload: 11-field PeerUpdate (365B OmniBuf, 341B Protobuf) + >16 KiB stress cases
============================================================================

### 1. Full Message Encode Speed

| Codec / Operation | Latency (ns/op) | Throughput (ops/sec) | Wire Size (B) | vs Baseline |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| OmniBuf (Generated) | 802 ns | 1,247,245 | 365 | 1.00x (baseline) |
| OmniBuf (Attributes) | 811 ns | 1,232,384 | 366 | 1.00x (baseline) |
| google/protobuf (pure PHP) | 87,188 ns | 11,470 | 341 | 108.71x slower |
| json_encode (stdlib) | 1,420 ns | 704,320 | 803 | 1.77x slower |

### 2. Full Message Decode Speed

| Codec / Operation | Latency (ns/op) | Throughput (ops/sec) | vs Baseline |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| OmniBuf (Generated) | 1,653 ns | 604,780 | 1.00x (baseline) |
| OmniBuf (Attributes) | 1,782 ns | 561,060 | 1.08x slower |
| google/protobuf (pure PHP) | 54,760 ns | 18,261 | 33.13x slower |
| json_decode (stdlib) | 4,287 ns | 233,267 | 2.59x slower |

### 3. Read a Single Nested Field

| Codec / Operation | Latency (ns/op) | Throughput (ops/sec) | vs Baseline |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| OmniBuf (Generated) | 513 ns | 1,948,700 | 1.00x (baseline) |
| google/protobuf (pure PHP) | 47,888 ns | 20,882 | 93.35x slower |
| json_decode (stdlib) | 3,692 ns | 270,853 | 7.20x slower |

### 4. Selective Single-Field Mutation

| Codec / Operation | Latency (ns/op) | Throughput (ops/sec) | vs Baseline |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| OmniBuf (Generated) | 1,514 ns | 660,344 | 1.00x (baseline) |
| google/protobuf (pure PHP) | 137,479 ns | 7,274 | 90.81x slower |
| json (stdlib) | 5,181 ns | 193,026 | 3.42x slower |

### 5. Large Embedded Message Encode

| Codec / Operation | Latency (ns/op) | Throughput (ops/sec) | Wire Size (B) | vs Baseline |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| OmniBuf (Generated) | 5,359 ns | 186,590 | 39255 | 1.00x (baseline) |
| OmniBuf (Attributes) | 5,505 ns | 181,653 | 39256 | 1.00x (baseline) |
| google/protobuf (pure PHP) | 1,168,719 ns | 856 | 39227 | 218.09x slower |
| json_encode (stdlib) | 23,293 ns | 42,931 | 39681 | 4.35x slower |

### 6. Embedded Message Growth

| Codec / Operation | Latency (ns/op) | Throughput (ops/sec) | vs Baseline |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| OmniBuf (Generated) | 4,432 ns | 225,622 | 1.00x (baseline) |
| google/protobuf (pure PHP) | 1,152,036 ns | 868 | 259.94x slower |
| json (stdlib) | 31,683 ns | 31,563 | 7.15x slower |
